records.key: spaCR AI allows three requests per minute. Try again at {time}.
records.source: spaCR AI allows three requests per minute. Try again at {time}.
records.translation: spaCR AI tillåter tre förfrågningar per minut. Försök igen kl. {time}.

records.key: spaCR AI error explanations are paused for one hour after repeated errors. Try again at {time}.
records.source: spaCR AI error explanations are paused for one hour after repeated errors. Try again at {time}.
records.translation: spaCR AI:s felförklaringar pausas i en timme efter upprepade fel. Försök igen kl. {time}.

records.key: Errors have continued for five minutes. Automatic error requests are paused.
records.source: Errors have continued for five minutes. Automatic error requests are paused.
records.translation: Fel har fortsatt att inträffa i fem minuter. Automatiska felförfrågningar har pausats.

records.key: Force quit stops spaCR immediately. Force restart starts a new spaCR process first. Work being written may be incomplete. Local logs are kept.
records.source: Force quit stops spaCR immediately. Force restart starts a new spaCR process first. Work being written may be incomplete. Local logs are kept.
records.translation: Tvångsavsluta stoppar spaCR omedelbart. Tvinga omstart startar först en ny spaCR-process. Arbete som håller på att skrivas kan vara ofullständigt. Lokala loggar sparas.

records.key: [AI] Errors are being combined until there have been 60 quiet seconds.
records.source: [AI] Errors are being combined until there have been 60 quiet seconds.
records.translation: [AI] Fel samlas ihop tills det har gått 60 sekunder utan nya fel.

records.key: [AI] spaCR could not restart. This window remains open.
records.source: [AI] spaCR could not restart. This window remains open.
records.translation: [AI] spaCR kunde inte starta om. Det här fönstret förblir öppet.
